verdict.rationale: Channel3's documented agent surfaces (API, MCP, CLI, UCP) cover product search, lookup, price tracking and sale attribution via buy URLs. Its UCP integration is scoped to "product search and lookup across stores". The pack contains no documented call for creating or updating a cart or order draft. A commerce API could plausibly offer this, so the axis applies, but it is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can create and update a cart or order draft through a documented protocol call
